correctness.rationale: All parameters and stochastic conventions are explicit. Itô conditional-generator equations produce exact 3x3 symmetric and antisymmetric moment blocks, whose cubic characteristic coefficients and Routh–Hurwitz determinants were reconstructed. The first-moment 2x2 blocks yield q(b-2a)<a². The second-moment positive block yields 4a²(a+q)-b²q>0; its antisymmetric block is stable whenever this holds, excluding a hidden earlier mode. At equality the irreducible Metzler Perron mode has eigenvalue zero and positive noise projection, proving linear growth; above equality it yields exponential growth. Solving the affine stationary equations gives the displayed covariance. Exact rational checks and RK4 diagnostics replay from artifacts/verify.py; finite computations are supporting diagnostics only. The critical covariance correlation limit equals 2a/b by direct substitution and the positive null eigenvector.

originality.rationale: The claim is an exact fully solved finite-dimensional alternating-shear phase diagram with different first/second-moment transition rates and a finite stationary covariance. Ferraro et al. already exhibit mean/variance separation in a distinct Gaussian-disordered large-N self-consistency model, Ogura and Preciado give general spectral stability criteria without these explicit shear-specific rates or stationary Brownian covariance, and Sturman and Thiffeault bound discrete random shear-product exponents. The explicit thresholds and exact nonempty gap were not present in the primary materials inspected, nor in the closest mathematical research records. Residual implicit-coverage risk remains; lack of exact matches is not considered proof of uniqueness.
residual_risks: A broader Markov-jump spectral theorem specializes algorithmically to this two-shear example, and a prior explicit evaluated example might exist under alternate parameters.
The stochastic-energetics and random-matrix literature may contain an unindexed special case with the same moments.
No independent publication-priority review has been performed.

value.rationale: Time-alternating directional couplings are a minimal physically interpretable annealed two-degree-of-freedom network. The exact finite-noise covariance and sharp, nonzero interval in which all means relax but variances diverge quantify a genuine failure of a commonly used mean-stability design criterion. The result is a complete natural phase classification, not a parameter-specific numerical increment or routine variance sample. The critical fluctuation direction also has an exact nonunit correlation ratio 2a/b.
